name: SmartFactoryControlRoom
description: Configuration-driven smart factory control room platform — Overview, Energy, Machines, Factory Map, Maintenance, Analytics
author: IS Control Room

properties.name: widgetTitle
properties.description: Title shown in the dashboard header (overrides config/app.config.js)

properties.name: theme
properties.description: Visual theme (themes are defined in config/theme.*.config.js)

properties.name: defaultPage
properties.description: Dashboard shown when the widget loads

properties.name: dataMode
properties.description: Auto = live when hosted in OMI, simulation otherwise. Simulation is always clearly badged in the header.

properties.name: tagPrefix
properties.description: Prefix prepended to every OMI tag address in config/tags.config.js — deploy the same package against different plants/areas by changing this
